**Stingwing Stew** is a consumable in *Fallout 76*.

A stew made from stingwing meat, with Tatoes and spices added.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Boiled Water (2) Spices (1) Stingwing Meat (2) Tato (2) Wood (1) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned from plan/recipe Recipe: Tasty Stingwing Stew | | Stingwing Stew (1) | 

- Can be crafted at any Cooking Station, after having learned the Recipe.
- May be sold by Yasmin Chowdhury.
